appDescription.message: Set a daily YouTube limit and see the days you kept it as streaks, XP and badges.

popup_signed_out_desc.message: Sign in and your streak and XP stay in sync across devices.

popup_emergency_blocked_schedule.message: Not available during a scheduled block

popup_sync_warning_never.message: This device hasn't synced yet. You can check under Options > Sync status.

popup_sync_warning_stale_one.message: Nothing has synced for $1 hour. You can check under Options > Sync status.

popup_sync_warning_stale_other.message: Nothing has synced for $1 hours. You can check under Options > Sync status.

auth_switch_to_sign_in.message: Already have an account? Sign in

auth_error_invalid_input.message: Enter an email and a password of at least 6 characters.

auth_error_generic.message: Something went wrong with that request.

auth_signed_in_done.message: Signed in. Close this tab and open the TubeLimiter popup again.

auth_signed_up_done.message: We sent a confirmation email. Check your inbox, then close this tab and sign in. (If email confirmation is off in your Supabase project, you can sign in right away.)

options_signed_out_desc.message: Sign in first to save your settings.

options_by_day_toggle.message: Set a different limit per weekday

options_shorts_limit_hint.message: Separate from the overall limit above. Once you pass it only Shorts pages are blocked; regular videos keep running on whatever is left of the overall limit. An emergency view unblocks it.

options_limit_lock_hint.message: 🔒 Hardcore mode is on, so the limits are locked. Turn hardcore mode off to change them.

options_hardcore_off_hint.message: Turning this on locks the limits above and starts tracking streaks. Turning it off takes an hour.

options_hardcore_request_off.message: Schedule the unlock (takes effect in an hour)

options_hardcore_off_streak_warning.message: Turning it off now resets your $1-day streak to zero.

options_hardcore_off_confirm.message: $1Turn hardcore mode off? It actually switches off an hour from now, and you can cancel any time before that. Go ahead?

options_alarm_interval_label.message: Remind me every N minutes (0 = off)

options_alarm_milestones_label.message: Remind me when time is running out (30/10/5/1 min left)

options_whitelist_placeholder.message: Part of a URL or channel name

options_schedule_hint.message: On the days and hours you pick, YouTube is blocked no matter what your limit says. Like focus mode, an emergency view won't get around it.

options_diagnostics_hint.message: The last successful sync and any failures since. This stays in this browser and is never sent anywhere. Nothing that identifies your account (email, tokens, user ID) is recorded.

options_diagnostics_copy_failed.message: Couldn't copy. Select the list and copy it by hand.

options_danger_desc.message: Deleting your account removes everything below, from the server and from this browser.

options_danger_item_settings.message: Settings (limits · allowlist · scheduled blocks and so on)

options_delete_confirm_label.message: Type the value below exactly to confirm

options_delete_confirm_message.message: Deleting your account permanently removes your account, watch time history, streaks and XP, badges and settings. This cannot be undone. Continue?

options_delete_failed.message: Couldn't delete: $1 — your account and records are still there.

options_account_deleted_hint.message: Your account, watch time history, streaks and XP, badges and settings are all gone, and the data stored in this browser was removed too. Sign up again whenever you'd like to come back.

dashboard_signed_out_desc.message: Sign in to see your dashboard.

dashboard_streak_caption_one.message: day in a row keeping the $1 limit

dashboard_streak_caption_other.message: days in a row keeping the $1 limit

dashboard_streak_locked_hint.message: 🔒 Turn on hardcore mode in Options and streaks and badges start being recorded.

dashboard_heatmap_legend.message: 💎 Dark green = perfect day (no emergency views) · light green = on target · red = over the limit

dashboard_hourly_note.message: This chart shows only this device — the hourly breakdown never leaves it.

dashboard_history_note_merged.message: The heatmap and watch time chart combine the records from every device on this account.

dashboard_history_note_local_only.message: Couldn't load the server records, so this is only what's stored on this device.

dashboard_perfect_badge_title_one.message: Kept the limit $1 day in a row with no emergency views

dashboard_perfect_badge_title_other.message: Kept the limit $1 days in a row with no emergency views

block_reason_focus_mode.message: Focus mode is on, so YouTube is paused.

block_reason_scheduled.message: This is a scheduled block, so YouTube is paused.

block_reason_manual.message: YouTube is blocked manually right now.

block_reason_always_shorts.message: Shorts are always blocked in your settings.

block_reason_shorts_limit.message: You've used up today's Shorts limit, so only Shorts are blocked. Regular videos still run on what's left of the overall limit.

block_reason_usage_limit.message: You've reached today's watch time limit, so YouTube is paused.

block_streak_note.message: You'll find out tomorrow whether today counted toward your streak.

notify_alarm_interval_one.message: You've been watching YouTube for $1 minute today.

notify_alarm_interval_other.message: You've been watching YouTube for $1 minutes today.

notify_alarm_milestone_one.message: $1 minute of YouTube time left today.

notify_alarm_milestone_other.message: $1 minutes of YouTube time left today.

notify_alarm_schedule_soon_one.message: A scheduled block starts in $1 minute.

notify_alarm_schedule_soon_other.message: A scheduled block starts in $1 minutes.

emergency_error_focus_mode.message: Emergency views aren't available during focus mode.

emergency_error_scheduled.message: Emergency views aren't available during a scheduled block.

emergency_error_no_uses.message: You have no emergency views left.
